findings.title: Buffer Overflow or Out-of-bounds Write
findings.trigger: If 'size * nmemb' is larger than the allocated size of 'ptr', it could lead to a buffer overflow.
findings.assumptions: The size of 'ptr' is not checked against 'size * nmemb' before copying data.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: If 'ptr' contains malicious input that could be interpreted as a command, it could lead to OS command injection.
findings.assumptions: The input is not sanitized before being printed.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: If 'ptr' contains special characters that could be interpreted as command-line options or control characters, it could lead to OS command injection.
findings.assumptions: The input is not sanitized before being printed.
